title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.2 contains 383 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks, in four types: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec–RTL consistency checking, plus 41 distractor controls and 41 consistent-RTL controls. Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt rather than training recall alone, though it does not rule out memorization of the unmutated source text helping a model spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.7% overall (129/383). On spec contradiction detection (t3), the primary verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0%; the distractor false-positive rate is 51.2%. On spec–RTL consistency (t4), the violation-vs.-compliant decision is effectively degenerate (MCC -0.06, balanced accuracy 49.5%), with the model flagging a violation on all 41 consistent-RTL controls; location accuracy remains measurable at 79.2% (lenient threshold, overlap ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 ). Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well but scores lower on their fine-grained category, suggesting as a hypothesis that the violation taxonomy is the hard part, though the category labels have not been independently validated. A structured “rule-table” prompting intervention on a 60-question sample lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring; a deterministic lenient-threshold variant is reported as a sensitivity analysis in the appendix. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件设计领域现有大语言模型（LLM）基准测试评估的是下游产物，例如生成的 RTL、断言或测试平台。 当模型在此类基准测试中失败时，其失败原因并不明确：它可能误解了规范，也可能理解了规范却未能写出正确的代码。 我们提出了 SpecRead，一个能够分离规范理解能力与生成能力的基准测试。 SpecRead v2.2 包含针对 10 个开源 OpenTitan IP 模块的 383 个问题，分为四类：精确检索、横截面推理、突变规范中的矛盾检测以及规范–RTL 一致性检查，此外还包括 41 个干扰项控制和 41 个 RTL 一致项控制。 第 4 类问题基于真实的 RTL 突变构建；我们仅保留 Icarus Verilog 模拟显示会改变可观测行为的突变。 有规范与无规范的消融分析表明，这些问题需要依赖所引用的规范片段，而非仅靠训练记忆；不过，这并未排除模型通过记忆未突变的源文本来识别突变的可能性。 作为使用小型模型进行的初步评估，Ministral-3B 的总体得分为 33.7%（129/383）。 在规范矛盾检测（t3）中，主要采用“判断+位置”的评估指标，得分为 48.0%；干扰项的误报率为 51.2%。 在规范–RTL 一致性（t4）中，“违规 vs 合规”的判断实际上已退化（MCC -0.06，平衡准确率 49.5%），模型在所有 41 个 RTL 一致控制项中均标记为违规；但位置识别的准确率仍可达 79.2%（宽松阈值，重叠度 ≥ 0.25）。 分层评分显示，模型能够准确定位矛盾，但在矛盾的具体细粒度类别上得分较低。据此我们提出一个假设：矛盾类型的分类可能是难点，尽管这些类别标签尚未经过独立验证。 在包含 60 个问题的样本中，采用结构化的“规则表”提示策略后，除 t2 外所有问题类型的准确率均下降（t2 得分不变）。 SpecRead 可通过确定性检查实现自动评分；保守的主评分方案将灰色地带案例计为错误，附录中还报告了一种基于宽松阈值的确定性变体作为敏感性分析。 该基准测试可通过注入突变对第 3 类问题重新生成，且全部内容均源自公开资源。

paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly applied to hardware design: writing RTL, generating assertions, and summarizing specifications. The benchmarks used to evaluate them, including VerilogEval [ 1 ] and RTLLM [ 3 ] , predominantly measure generation : given a specification or natural-language description, produce an artifact and check it by simulation or formal equivalence.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型正越来越多地应用于硬件设计：编写 RTL、生成断言以及总结规格说明。 用于评估这些模型的基准测试，包括 VerilogEval [ 1 ] 和 RTLLM [ 3 ]，主要衡量生成能力：在给定规格说明或自然语言描述时，生成一个产物，并通过仿真或形式等价性检查来验证它。

paragraphs.en: Generation benchmarks conflate two distinct capabilities. Consider a model that writes incorrect RTL for a UART baud-rate divider. Did it misread the specification (a comprehension failure), or did it understand the specification and fail at Verilog syntax, timing discipline, or state-machine encoding (a production failure)? The benchmark cannot tell, and the distinction determines whether to invest in spec-grounded reasoning or in code synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 生成基准测试将两种截然不同的能力混为一谈。 假设一个模型为 UART 波特率分频器编写了错误的 RTL 代码。 它是误解了规范（理解失败），还是理解了规范却在 Verilog 语法、时序约束或状态机编码上出错（实现失败）？ 该基准测试无法分辨，而这种区别决定了应该投资基于规范的推理，还是投资于代码合成。

paragraphs.en: Type 3 (contradiction detection). We apply controlled mutations (number changes, rule inversions, cross-reference conflicts, deleted conditions) to real specification text and ask the model to locate and classify the contradiction. Distractor items, real unmutated passages that merely look suspicious, control the false-positive rate.
paragraphs.zh: 类型 3（矛盾检测）。 我们对真实的规范文本施加受控变异（数字变化、规则反转、交叉引用冲突、条件删除），并要求模型定位并分类矛盾。 干扰项，即那些仅看起来可疑但实际未变异的段落，用于控制误报率。

sents.zh: 类型 3（矛盾检测）。

paragraphs.en: Type 4 (spec–RTL consistency). We mutate real RTL, verify by simulation that the mutation changes observable behavior, and ask whether the mutated RTL still matches the specification. The model must connect natural-language rules to Verilog semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 类型 4（规格–RTL 一致性）。 我们对真实的 RTL 进行变异，通过仿真验证该变异是否改变了可观察行为，并判断变异后的 RTL 是否与规格仍然匹配。 该模型必须将自然语言规则与 Verilog 的语义连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (1) the SpecRead benchmark (383 questions, 10 IPs, automatically scored); (2) a mutation-injection methodology that makes type-3 items regenerable and therefore more resistant to training-data contamination; (3) type-4 items filtered by simulation to guarantee an observable behavioral change; and (4) an initial single-model characterization on a small open model, with a fine-grained failure taxonomy. We frame the paper as a benchmark release plus this single-model characterization; with one 3B model evaluated, we make no claim that the difficulty profile is discriminative across models or that it transfers to larger or frontier models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括：(1) SpecRead基准测试（包含383个问题、10个IP，支持自动评分）；(2) 一种突变注入方法，使类型3的题目可再生，从而更抗训练数据污染；(3) 通过模拟筛选出的类型4题目，以确保行为变化可被观察到；以及 (4) 在一个小型开放模型上进行的初步单模型特征分析，并附有精细的失败分类体系。 我们将本文框架定义为基准测试发布与上述单模型特征分析的结合；由于仅评估了一个3B模型，我们并未声称其难度特征在不同模型间具有区分性，也未声称其能迁移到更大或更前沿的模型上。

paragraphs.en: VerilogEval [ 1 , 2 ] and RTLLM [ 3 ] established the paradigm of evaluating LLMs by the functional correctness of generated Verilog. Follow-up work extended it to assertions (AssertLLM [ 4 ] , AssertLLM2 [ 5 ] ), testbenches (AutoBench [ 6 ] ), and multi-turn repair. These benchmarks measure the end of the pipeline; none isolates whether the model understood its input.
paragraphs.zh: VerilogEval [ 1 , 2 ] 和 RTLLM [ 3 ] 确立了通过所生成 Verilog 的功能正确性来评估 LLM 的范式。 后续工作将其扩展到了断言（AssertLLM [ 4 ] 、 AssertLLM2 [ 5 ] ）、测试平台（AutoBench [ 6 ] ）以及多轮修复。 这些基准测试衡量的是流程的末端；没有任何一个能够单独判断模型是否理解了其输入。

paragraphs.en: Regenerable items, private held-out sets, and dynamic benchmark construction are active concerns across LLM evaluation [ 12 , 13 ] . SpecRead’s mutation injection follows this spirit: because type-3 items are generated by scripted mutation of public text, fresh instances can be produced on demand. (Type-4 items require hand-built testbenches and simulation filtering, so they are not regenerable by the same scripted pipeline; see Limitations.)
paragraphs.zh: 可再生项目、私有保留集以及动态基准构建是当前大型语言模型评估中的活跃议题 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 SpecRead 的突变注入遵循这一理念：由于类型 3 项目是通过脚本对公开文本进行突变生成的，因此可以按需生成新的实例。 （类型 4 项目需要手动构建测试平台和模拟过滤，因此无法通过相同的脚本流程再生；参见“局限性”部分。）

paragraphs.en: The closest existing work evaluates comprehension indirectly: generating RTL from a specification and then checking the RTL (round-trip), analyzing characteristic spec-misreading errors, or the reverse direction of RTL-to-spec summarization (RTL-BenchLS [ 7 ] ). CVDP [ 8 ] includes an RTL-to/from-specification correspondence category (34 problems), but scores it with BLEU and LLM-based judging rather than deterministic gold labels. The nearest neighbors on each side are VClare [ 9 ] , which injects specification defects including contradictions but measures repair outcomes (Verilog pass rate) rather than comprehension, and AssertLLM2 [ 5 ] , whose bug-hunting setting uses mutated RTL but scores generated assertions rather than direct consistency judgments, without simulation-filtering mutations for observable difference. To our knowledge, no existing benchmark directly scores specification comprehension itself: asking the model to detect, locate, and classify contradictions in a specification, or to judge spec–RTL consistency, against gold labels with scoring decoupled from generation ability. Characteristic spec-misreading failures (“Type II” errors) are a documented confound in RTL generation [ 10 ] ; SpecRead isolates exactly that confound.
paragraphs.zh: 目前最接近的研究以间接方式评估理解能力：从规范生成RTL，然后检查该RTL（往返验证），分析典型的规范误读错误，或采用从RTL到规范的总结方向（RTL-BenchLS [ 7 ]）。 CVDP [ 8 ] 包含一个从规范到/从规范到RTL的对应关系类别（34个问题），但使用BLEU和基于LLM的评判进行评分，而非确定性黄金标签。 两侧最接近的相关研究是VClare [ 9 ]，它会注入包括矛盾在内的规范缺陷，但衡量的是修复结果（Verilog通过率）而非理解能力；以及AssertLLM2 [ 5 ]，其故障排查设置使用了变异的RTL，但评分对象是生成的断言，而非直接的兼容性判断，且未通过模拟过滤变异以产生可观察的差异。 据我们所知，目前没有任何基准直接对规范理解本身进行评分：即要求模型检测、定位和分类规范中的矛盾，或判断规范与RTL的一致性，并基于黄金标签进行评分，同时该评分与生成能力分离。 典型的规范误读失败（“II型”错误）是RTL生成中已知的干扰因素 [ 10]；SpecRead专门隔离了这一干扰因素。

paragraphs.en: Type-3 items are a domain-specific form of contradiction detection over long documents. General NLI benchmarks (DocNLI [ 17 ] , ContractNLI [ 18 ] ) and factual-consistency metrics (SummaC [ 19 ] ) test whether models detect inconsistencies between texts, but on news or contract domains with different linguistic structure than hardware specifications. Long-document QA and contextual NLI (ConTRoL [ 20 ] ) share the multi-hop reasoning demand of type-2 items. SpecRead differs in grounding contradictions in executable hardware semantics: type-4 mutations are simulation-verified to change observable behavior, a guarantee no text-only NLI benchmark provides.

paragraphs.en: We apply one scripted mutation to a real excerpt and ask the model either to identify the contradiction (location and category) or to reply NO_CONTRADICTION . Mutation operators are changed number (e.g., “9/11/13 rounds” instead of the documented values), rule inversion (polarity flips), cross-reference conflict (a table row contradicting prose), and deleted condition (a dropped qualifier creating an over-generalization). The corresponding categories are NUMERIC_MISMATCH , RULE_INVERSION , CROSSREF_CONFLICT , and MISSING_CONDITION . Mutations are applied by exact-match scripted replacement, and the mutated sentence is kept fluent to avoid “looks edited” cues. Operator counts: changed_number 53, rule_inversion 51, deleted_condition 37, crossref_conflict 30. The resulting gold categories are NUMERIC_MISMATCH 50, RULE_INVERSION 45, CROSSREF_CONFLICT 39, MISSING_CONDITION 37(9 items’ gold category differs from the generating operator’s default mapping).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对真实文本片段应用一次脚本化变异，并要求模型要么识别出矛盾之处（位置和类别），要么回复 NO_CONTRADICTION。 变异操作符包括数字变更（例如，用“9/11/13 rounds”替代文档中的原始数值）、规则反转（极性翻转）、交叉引用冲突（表格行与正文内容矛盾）以及条件删除（省略限定词导致过度泛化）。 对应的类别为 NUMERIC_MISMATCH、RULE_INVERSION、CROSSREF_CONFLICT 和 MISSING_CONDITION。 变异通过精确匹配的脚本化替换来实施，同时保持变异后的句子流畅，以避免出现“经过编辑”的提示。 操作符数量：changed_number 53，rule_inversion 51，deleted_condition 37，crossref_conflict 30。 最终确定的标准类别为 NUMERIC_MISMATCH 50，RULE_INVERSION 45，CROSSREF_CONFLICT 39，MISSING_CONDITION 37（其中 9 个项目的标准类别与其生成操作符的默认映射不同）。

paragraphs.en: We mutate real RTL (single-line substitutions or small deletions), simulate the original and mutated modules under Icarus Verilog [ 15 ] with a purpose-built testbench, and retain only mutations whose waveforms differ. Candidate RTL mutations were proposed by hand for each IP and simulated under purpose-built testbenches; only mutations with RESULT: DIFFER were retained, leaving 96. No single candidate/discard ledger was kept; per-IP review notes document 26 discarded candidates, dropped for behavioral equivalence under the testbench, Icarus Verilog quirks, or lack of a spec witness. A behavioral difference from the original RTL does not by itself imply a specification violation, since the changed behavior could fall in an unspecified region; at item-authoring time the author therefore wrote, for each of the 96 retained items, a gold answer citing the specific spec clause the mutation violates (a rule field plus an explanation linking the mutated line to that clause, present in 96/96 items). The model receives the specification excerpt and the mutated RTL excerpt and must judge consistency, citing the location and one of the four categories. Category mapping for RTL mutations: NUMERIC_MISMATCH (50 items) for mutations changing a numeric constant, width, or count contradicting a spec-stated value; RULE_INVERSION (25) for mutations inverting a logical condition or polarity (e.g., active-high vs. active-low); MISSING_CONDITION (16) for mutations deleting a guard, check, or reset the spec requires; CROSSREF_CONFLICT (5) for mutations whose violation is visible only by cross-referencing two spec clauses (e.g., a bark/bite threshold swap where each register is defined separately). The NUMERIC_MISMATCH / RULE_INVERSION boundary is genuinely ambiguous for mutations like a numeric change that inverts a comparison; see Failure Analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对真实的 RTL 代码进行变异（单行替换或小范围删除），使用专门设计的测试平台在 Icarus Verilog [ 15 ] 中模拟原始模块和变异后的模块，并仅保留波形存在差异的变异。 每个 IP 的候选 RTL 变异均通过人工提出，并在专门设计的测试平台中进行模拟；仅保留 RESULT: DIFFER 的变异，最终保留了 96 个。 我们没有保存统一的候选/淘汰清单；每个 IP 的评审记录文档记录了 26 个被淘汰的候选项，这些候选项因在测试平台下行为等效、Icarus Verilog 的特殊行为，或缺乏规范依据而被舍弃。 与原始 RTL 的行为差异本身并不必然意味着违反规范，因为改变后的行为可能处于规范未明确规定的区域；因此，在条目撰写阶段，作者为保留的 96 个条目分别编写了标准答案，明确指出该变异违反了规范的哪一条款（包括规则字段以及将变异行与该条款关联的解释，96 个条目均包含此信息）。 模型会接收规范节选和变异后的 RTL 节选，并必须判断二者是否一致，同时指出具体位置及所属的四个类别之一。 RTL 变异的类别映射：NUMERIC_MISMATCH（50 个条目）指改变数值常量、位宽或计数量的变异，导致与规范中规定的值矛盾；RULE_INVERSION（25 个）指逻辑条件或极性发生反转的变异（例如，高电平有效变为低电平有效）；MISSING_CONDITION（16 个）指删除了规范所要求的防护条件、检查条件或复位条件的变异；CROSSREF_CONFLICT（5 个）指必须通过交叉引用两条规范条款才能发现其违规的变异（例如， bark/bite 阈值互换，而每个寄存器是单独定义的）。 对于像数值变化导致比较结果反转这类变异，NUMERIC_MISMATCH 与 RULE_INVERSION 的界限确实存在模糊性；参见故障分析部分。

sents.en: The NUMERIC_MISMATCH / RULE_INVERSION boundary is genuinely ambiguous for mutations like a numeric change that inverts a comparison; see Failure Analysis.
sents.zh: 对于像数值变化导致比较结果反转这类变异，NUMERIC_MISMATCH 与 RULE_INVERSION 的界限确实存在模糊性；参见故障分析部分。

paragraphs.en: The 41 distractor items are real, unmutated excerpts that look suspicious but are self-consistent: reset-value subtleties, level- vs. event-triggered interrupt semantics, reserved register fields, x reset values, and read-to-clear behavior. They are interleaved with the main set, so a model that flags anything unusual as a contradiction accumulates false positives. Of an initial 42 distractors, one ( uart-t3d-003 ) was dropped as an exact duplicate prompt of uart-t3d-001 . Distractors are presented in the type-3 format.
paragraphs.zh: 这 41 个干扰项是真实且未经修改的片段，它们看似可疑但内部自洽：包括重置值的细微差别、按级别触发的中断语义与按事件触发的中断语义的区别、保留的寄存器字段、x 重置值以及“读取即清除”行为。 这些干扰项与主数据集交错呈现，因此任何将异常内容标记为矛盾点的模型都会积累误报。 在最初的 42 个干扰项中，有一个（uart-t3d-003）因与 uart-t3d-001 完全重复而被舍弃。 干扰项以类型 3 的格式呈现。

paragraphs.en: We also built 41 consistent-RTL controls for type 4: real, unmutated RTL excerpts paired with their specification passages, presented in the type-4 format, for which the correct verdict is NO_CONTRADICTION . paragraphs.en: The main results use conservative automatic scoring: deterministic checks only, with every gray-zone case counted wrong. Type 1 uses strict normalized exact match; type 2 uses exact match or multiple-choice letter match. For types 3 and 4 the primary measure is verdict plus location: did the model find the contradiction and cite the right place? The category label is a secondary , finer-grained measure, since the four violation categories are not perfectly mutually exclusive (e.g., a numeric change inside a cross-referenced table). A cited location is checked by distinctive-token overlap against the gold location: overlap ≥ 0.45 \geq 0.45 counts as correct, < 0.25 <0.25 as wrong, and the gray zone in between is counted wrong under the conservative scoring, with no human or LLM judgment involved. As a precision guard, citations quoting more than five times the gold location’s distinctive tokens fall into the gray zone rather than auto-scoring, so the recall-style overlap check cannot be gamed with overly broad quotes. Full credit on an item requires the primary verdict-plus-location plus the correct category. The conservative scores are fully reproducible by running score_main.py --conservative and score_layered.py --conservative in the released repository.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结果采用了保守的自动评分方法：仅进行确定性检查，所有灰色地带案例均计为错误。 类型 1 使用严格的归一化精确匹配；类型 2 使用精确匹配或多选字母匹配。 对于类型 3 和 4，主要衡量标准是判断结果加位置：模型是否发现了矛盾并引用了正确的位置？ 类别标签是一个次要的、更精细的衡量指标，因为四种违规类别并非完全互斥（例如，交叉引用的表格中出现的数值变化）。 所引用的位置通过与标准位置的独特标记重叠度进行验证：重叠度 ≥ 0.45 \geq 0.45 计为正确，< 0.25 <0.25 计为错误，而介于两者之间的灰色地带在保守评分下均计为错误，且不涉及人工或 LLM 的判断。 作为精确度保障，引用中独特标记数量超过标准位置五倍的案例将落入灰色地带而非自动评分，因此无法通过过度宽泛的引用来操纵召回式重叠检查。 要获得某项任务的完整分数，必须同时满足主要判断结果加位置以及正确的类别要求。 保守评分完全可以通过在已发布的仓库中运行 score_main.py --conservative 和 score_layered.py --conservative 来复现。

paragraphs.en: To check the gray-zone adjudication rubric, 93 gray-zone t3/t4 responses from the Ministral-3B run underwent an LLM-assisted consistency check: the first annotator was the author’s AI research assistant (Muse Spark by Meta), and the second was Claude Opus 5.5, instructed to judge each item on the rubric alone (same planted location plus exact category match). The second annotation was designed as blinded to the first round’s verdicts; on two batches the second annotator was inadvertently shown the first annotator’s comparison notes, and confirmed disregarding them and judging from the items alone. Because both annotators are language models, we describe this as a consistency check rather than independent validation. Raw agreement was 83/93 (89.2%, Cohen’s κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77 ). Excluding the two affected batches, agreement was 52/60 (86.7%, κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 ), so the headline figure is not driven by the leak. All 10 disagreements were re-examined against the raw model responses: 5 resolved in favor of the first annotator’s reading and 5 in favor of the second’s, including 2 where the first round’s notes contained transcription errors, yielding merged labels of 33/93 correct and 60/93 wrong (per-item provenance in build/eval/merged_gray_labels_v2.json ). Disagreement concentrated on location-precision standards for partial responses, indicating the rubric is stable except at the boundary cases it was designed to probe. The 93 items comprise all t3/t4 responses where the automatic location check fell into the gray zone (overlap 0.25–0.45) or triggered the precision guard, i.e., every case the conservative scorer counts wrong for location uncertainty; this is a superset of the lenient-minus-strict difference, which counts only gray-zone items whose category was also correct. Two scoring details: (i) the precision guard (cited tokens > > 5 × \times gold tokens → \to wrong) applies only under conservative scoring; under the lenient 0.25 threshold, a precision-guard item counts correct if its overlap meets the bar. (ii) Conservative t4 verdict+location uses the same token-overlap check as t3 (threshold 0.45); the mutation-aware check (cited code must contain the mutated snippet’s distinctive tokens) is used only in the layered/lenient scoring, where the threshold is 0.25.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验灰色地带裁决标准，Ministral-3B运行中产生的93条灰色地带t3/t4响应接受了LLM辅助的一致性检查：第一位标注者是作者的人工智能研究助理（Meta的Muse Spark），第二位是Claude Opus 5.5，其指令是仅依据标准中的各项内容对每个条目进行判断（植入位置相同且类别完全匹配）。 第二轮标注被设计为对第一轮裁决结果不知情；在两个批次中，第二位标注者意外看到了第一位标注者的对比笔记，但确认自己忽略了这些笔记，并仅根据条目本身进行判断。 由于两位标注者都是语言模型，我们将此过程描述为一致性检查，而非独立验证。 原始一致率为83/93（89.2%，科恩κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77）。 排除受影响的两个批次后，一致率为52/60（86.7%，κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72），因此主要结果并非由信息泄露所导致。 所有10处分歧均依据原始模型响应进行了重新审查：其中5处支持第一位标注者的解读，5处支持第二位标注者的解读；包括2处第一轮笔记存在转录错误，最终合并后的标签为33/93正确、60/93错误（各条目的来源见build/eval/merged_gray_labels_v2.json）。 分歧主要集中在部分响应的定位精度标准上，表明该裁决标准在边界案例之外是稳定的，而这些边界案例正是其设计初衷要探究的。 这93个条目涵盖了所有自动定位检查落入灰色地带（重叠度0.25–0.45）或触发精度防护机制的t3/t4响应，即保守评分法因定位不确定性而判为错误的全部情况；这是宽松与严格评分差异的一个超集，后者仅计算类别也正确的灰色地带条目。 评分有两个细节：(i) 精度防护机制（引用词元数 > > 5 × \times 黄金词元数 → \to 错误）仅在保守评分下适用；在宽松的0.25阈值下，若重叠度达到标准，则精度防护条目会被判为正确。 (ii) 保守的t4裁决+定位使用与t3相同的词元重叠检查（阈值0.45）；突变感知检查（引用代码必须包含突变片段的特征词元）仅在分层/宽松评分中使用，此时阈值为0.25。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is the strongest type on full credit at 55.2%, and cross-section reasoning reaches 51.7% after the multiple-choice repair. (The t4 verdict-plus-location figure of 65.6% is higher but uses a weaker criterion; on full credit t1 remains the strongest.) On the two contradiction-focused types, which have no generation-benchmark analogue, the primary verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% for spec contradiction (t3, 82/171) and 65.6% for spec–RTL consistency (t4, 63/96). Full credit (verdict, location, and category) is lower at 24.6% and 26.0%, reflecting the category-classification gap discussed below. For context, the deterministic baselines are 50.0% verdict balanced accuracy for an always-violation predictor (t3 and t4), 25.0% expected category accuracy for random labels, and 35.2% t3 location accuracy for a diff-against-upstream string comparison (57/162 on 162 items; 95% CI [0.283, 0.428]; 9 items skipped where direct mutation reversal was impossible, vs. the model’s 135/171 on all 171), which bounds how much of the location sub-task is solvable by memorized-source comparison alone. The diff baseline is modest because the gold location cites the contradiction pair (the mutated sentence plus the statement it conflicts with), while diffing recovers only the mutated sentence itself; a perfect diff thus earns only partial overlap with the gold location. Both use the conservative location rule (overlap ≥ 0.45 \geq 0.45 with precision guard).
paragraphs.zh: 检索是表现最强的类型，满分为 55.2%；经过多项选择修复后，横截面推理的得分达到 51.7%。 （t4 的“判决加位置”指标为 65.6%，虽然更高，但使用的是较弱的评判标准；在满分情况下，t1 仍然是最强的。）在两种以矛盾为核心的类型上（这些类型在生成基准中没有对应项），主要的“判决加位置”指标显示：对于规范矛盾，得分为 48.0%（t3，82/171）；对于规范–RTL 一致性，得分为 65.6%（t4，63/96）。 满分（包括判决、位置和类别）的得分较低，分别为 24.6% 和 26.0%，这反映了下文讨论的类别分类差距。 作为参考，确定性基线模型的表现如下：始终预测违规的模型在判决平衡准确率上为 50.0%（t3 和 t4）；随机标签的预期类别准确率为 25.0%；而通过“与上游字符串差异比较”（162 项中得 57/162；95% 置信区间 [0.283, 0.428]；其中 9 项因无法直接逆转突变而被跳过，而模型在所有 171 项中的得分为 135/171）的 t3 位置准确率为 35.2%，这一结果界定了仅通过记忆源文本比较能够解决的位置子任务的比例。 “差异”基线模型的表现一般，因为标准答案中的位置引用了矛盾对（即被突变的句子及其冲突的陈述），而差异比较仅能恢复出被突变的句子本身；因此，即使差异比较完全正确，也与标准答案的位置仅有部分重叠。 两者都采用了保守的位置规则（重叠度 ≥ 0.45 \geq 0.45，并设有精确度保护）。

paragraphs.en: The 51.2% distractor false-positive rate is a finding in its own right. The model is easily misled by suspicious-looking but self-consistent passages; it over-flags rather than under-flags. On the t3 verdict-level decision (171 mutated items, gold: violation; 41 distractors, gold: consistent), the model flags a violation on 171/171 mutations and 21/41 distractors: TPR 100.0%, TNR 48.8%, balanced accuracy 74.4%. This is the one non-degenerate verdict signal in the paper: unlike t4, the model does produce the compliant verdict on self-consistent spec passages about half the time.

paragraphs.en: The 100% false-positive rate on t4 controls could in principle be an artifact of the prompt’s verdict-commit instruction (“You must commit to a verdict”). To test this, we re-ran all 41 t4 controls with a variant prompt whose instruction instead begins “The RTL excerpt may be fully compliant with the specification” (everything else byte-identical; same model, temperature 0, deterministic item order). The model still flagged a violation on 41/41 controls (100.0%, 95% Wilson CI 91.4–100.0). The over-flagging bias is robust to this prompt wording; it is not explained by the verdict-commit instruction alone. (Raw responses and prompt hashes in build/eval/responses_controls_mistral_promptvar.jsonl .)

paragraphs.en: A 30-question pilot on OpenTitan UART preceded the full build as a difficulty check, run on gemini-flash-lite-latest (16/30) and ministral-3b-latest (14/30). Both pilot models scored below the 60% bar that would have triggered hardening, and missed most planted contradictions rather than over-flagging, which motivated the full build. (Pilot records are in pilot/model_testing/ in the repository.) The pilot under-flagging contrasts with the main model’s over-flagging on distractors and t4 controls, a difference we attribute to the full build’s harder distractor set and the t4 control format rather than to a model change. Evaluation of larger models on the identical 465 prompts is left to a future revision; all numbers in this paper are for Ministral-3B, and we do not claim that the difficulty profile transfers to frontier models.
paragraphs.zh: 在完整构建之前，先进行了一项包含 30 道题的 OpenTitan UART 试点测试，以检验难度；该测试在 gemini-flash-lite-latest（16/30）和 ministral-3b-latest（14/30）上运行。 两项试点模型的成绩均低于触发强化机制的 60% 阈值，且多数植入的矛盾点未被识别，而非过度标记；这一结果促使我们进行了完整构建。 （试点记录位于仓库的 pilot/model_testing/ 目录下。）试点中的标记不足现象与主模型在干扰项和 t4 控制集上的过度标记形成对比；我们认为这种差异源于完整构建中更难的干扰项集合以及 t4 控制格式，而非模型本身的变更。 对更大模型在相同 465 个提示词上的评估留待未来版本完成；本文中的所有数据均基于 Ministral-3B，我们并未声称其难度特征能迁移到前沿模型上。

The sample is one item per IP for t1/t2 and two per IP for t3/t4, taking the lowest-numbered IDs per IP: deterministic and stratified by IP, not a uniform random draw. The 60-question sample was scored with the same deterministic conservative scorer as the main results (gray-zone cases counted wrong; the author’s AI research assistant spot-checked the gray-zone items and confirmed the automatic verdicts without changes). The with-spec sample scores 60.0% (t1), 40.0% (t2), 45.0% (t3), 15.0% (t4), and 36.7% overall, against conservative full-set scores of 55.2%, 51.7%, 24.6% (full credit; 48.0% verdict-plus-location), 26.0% (full credit; 65.6% verdict-plus-location), and 33.7%. paragraphs.en: The contamination conclusion from this ablation is restricted to t1 and t2: without the excerpt, t1 accuracy drops to 0.0% and t2 to 30.0%, showing these questions require reading the provided text rather than recalling training data. The small t2 delta is expected: 3 of the 10 sampled t2 questions are answerable or guessable without the excerpt, which is exactly what the ablation is designed to detect. For t3 and t4, the without-spec condition is uninformative by construction: the without-spec prompt contains the question only (no excerpt and, for t4, no RTL), so locating a planted contradiction or judging spec–RTL consistency is impossible without the material the question is about. We draw no contamination conclusion for t3/t4 from this ablation. Note further that even for t3, the ablation does not rule out that memorized knowledge of the unmutated OpenTitan text helps a model notice a mutation; contamination resistance for the mutated types rests on regenerability (fresh mutations on demand) rather than on this ablation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 本次消融实验得出的污染结论仅限于 t1 和 t2：若没有该摘录，t1 的准确率会降至 0.0%，t2 则会降至 30.0%，这表明这些问题需要阅读所提供的文本，而非回忆训练数据。 t2 的微小差异在预期之中：在抽取的 10 个 t2 问题中，有 3 个问题无需摘录也能回答或猜测，而这正是本次消融实验旨在检测的情况。 对于 t3 和 t4，“无说明”条件本身就无法提供有效信息：“无说明”提示仅包含问题（没有摘录，对 t4 而言也没有 RTL），因此，若没有问题所涉及的素材，就不可能发现预设的矛盾或判断说明与 RTL 之间的一致性。 基于本次消融实验，我们对 t3/t4 无法得出任何污染结论。 此外还需注意，即使对于 t3，本次消融实验也无法排除模型凭借对未突变 OpenTitan 文本的记忆来察觉突变的可能性；对于突变类型而言，其抗污染能力取决于可再生性（按需生成新的突变），而不仅仅依赖于本次消融实验。

paragraphs.en: A two-step prompting intervention first extracts the excerpt into a numbered rule table and then answers using only the table. On the same 60-question sample it lowers accuracy on every type except t2 (tied): t1 -0.300 (6/10 to 3/10), t2 0.000 (4/10 to 4/10), t3 -0.100 (9/20 to 7/20), t4 -0.150 (3/20 to 0/20), overall -0.133 (22/60 to 14/60). A McNemar exact test on the 60 paired outcomes gives p = 0.039 p=0.039 (10 discordant pairs favoring the standard prompt, 2 favoring rule-table), so the degradation is statistically significant at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . Step-1 extraction is faithful (spot-checked tables preserve the mutated numbers); the loss occurs in step 2 through recombination failures, hedging instead of committing to a verdict, and paraphrase drift penalized by strict scoring. For a 3B model, structured extraction does not help specification reading; it hurts.
paragraphs.zh: 一种两步提示干预方法首先将摘录提取为带编号的规则表，然后仅使用该表格进行回答。 在相同的60道题样本中，该方法降低了除 t2（打平）以外的所有类型准确率：t1 -0.300（从6/10降至3/10），t2 0.000（4/10保持不变），t3 -0.100（从9/20降至7/20），t4 -0.150（从3/20降至0/20），总体准确率下降-0.133（从22/60降至14/60）。 对60个配对结果进行麦克尼马尔精确检验，得到 p = 0.039 p=0.039（10对不一致结果支持标准提示，2对支持规则表），因此在 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 的显著性水平下，这种性能下降具有统计学意义。 第一步的提取过程是忠实的（经抽查确认表格保留了变异后的数值）；损失发生在第二步，原因包括重组失败、采取回避策略而非明确给出结论，以及因严格评分机制而受到惩罚的改写偏差。 对于3B模型，结构化提取无助于规范解读，反而会产生负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Layered scoring separates verdict/location (did the model find the contradiction?) from category (did it label the violation type correctly?). On t3, the model cites the correct location on 135/171 items (78.9%) but the correct category on only 85/171 (49.7%); both correct on 69/171 (40.4%). On t4, using a mutation-aware location check (the cited code must contain the mutated snippet’s distinctive tokens), location accuracy is 76/96 (79.2%), category 43/96 (44.8%), both 35/96 (36.5%). The t4 check differs from t3’s token-overlap rule because t4 responses cite RTL code: a generic overlap could match surrounding unmutated lines, so the check specifically requires the mutated snippet’s tokens, ensuring the model found the actual mutation rather than nearby context. The layered location bar is the lenient “not wrong” boundary (overlap ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 ), so the “both” figures exceed the conservative strict scores (42/171, 25/96), which count every gray-zone case wrong: the gap between “both” and strict is exactly the gray zone. The pattern is the same on both types: the model usually finds the discrepancy but misclassifies it. We state this as a hypothesis, not a firm conclusion: the fine-grained violation taxonomy may be the hard part for this model, as opposed to spotting that something is wrong. The hypothesis is confounded with label ambiguity: the four category labels have not been independently validated, and for RTL mutations NUMERIC_MISMATCH and RULE_INVERSION often overlap (e.g., a numeric change that inverts a comparison), so part of the “misclassification” may reflect genuinely ambiguous gold labels rather than model failure. Category confusion matrices (Tables 4 , 2 ) show the dominant errors: on t3, the model over-predicts CROSSREF_CONFLICT , mislabeling 19 RULE_INVERSION and 18 MISSING_CONDITION items as cross-reference conflicts. On t4 the dominant error is different: 26 NUMERIC_MISMATCH items mislabeled as RULE_INVERSION (vs. only 3 such errors on t3).

paragraphs.en: A natural next step is to test whether SpecRead scores predict downstream generation failures: do models that misread specifications here also commit more specification-misreading errors on VerilogEval-style generation tasks? The failure modes above (right region, wrong precise conflict) suggest the errors would transfer, but a quantitative correlation study is left to future work. By mutation operator on t3, numeric edits are the easiest to catch and dropped conditions the hardest (Table 6 ): the model notices altered numbers but never gets a deleted_condition item fully right (0/37 strict), the subtlest operator. A location-only re-analysis of the 37 deleted_condition items (counting a response as finding the conflict when its cited location overlaps the gold location above the automatic-wrong threshold, ignoring category) rises from 0/37 strict to 28/37 (75.7%), confirming that even on the hardest operator the model usually sees the conflict but cannot name its type.

paragraphs.en: (1) Only one small open model (Ministral-3B) is evaluated; conclusions about difficulty may not transfer to larger or frontier models, which we did not evaluate (resource constraint). (2) All sources come from a single project (OpenTitan); cross-project generality is untested. (3) Specifications are English prose plus register tables; other documentation styles (e.g., assertions as specification) are not covered. (4) Type-4 items use small, simulation-observable mutations; deep microarchitectural changes are out of scope, and a simulation difference from the original RTL is a proxy for, not a proof of, a specification violation. (5) Strict exact-match scoring conflates retrieval with formatting discipline for small models. (6) The main results use conservative scoring (gray-zone cases counted wrong). A deterministic lenient-threshold variant (location overlap ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 ) appears only in the appendix sensitivity analysis; no second annotator reviewed the 96 t4 gold labels, and the category labels have not been independently validated (see Failure Analysis). The gray-zone adjudication rubric itself was checked by LLM-assisted double annotation ( κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77 on 93 items, κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 excluding two batches with inadvertent exposure; see Scoring). (7) The t4 control false-positive rate (41/41) rests on 41 items; the controls were fairness-audited but a larger control set would tighten the interval. Combining the 96 mutations with the 41 controls, the violation-vs.-compliant decision has balanced accuracy 49.5% and MCC -0.06 (see Results): for this small model the decision is effectively degenerate. (8) Regenerability via mutation injection applies to type-3 items; type-4 items require hand-built testbenches and simulation filtering, so they are not regenerable by the same scripted pipeline. (9) No human baseline is reported; the benchmark measures model behavior, not human difficulty. (10) Post-hoc gold audit (2026-09-27): a review by Claude Opus 5.5 of the nine flagged gold labels found two items indefensible (one t4 item whose gold rule does not govern the mutated behavior with no supporting specification text; one AES item functionally identical to another), both removed from the dataset (v2.2, 383 questions); seven further items received excerpt expansions or clarified gold explanations without changing their gold verdicts.

paragraphs.en: SpecRead separates understanding a hardware specification from producing hardware artifacts. As a benchmark release with an initial single-model characterization, it shows that on a small open model there is a clear gap: 33.7% overall (129/383; macro average 39.4%), 48.0–65.6% verdict-plus-location on the two contradiction-focused types that have no generation-benchmark analogue, a 51.2% false-positive rate on self-consistent passages, and a 100% false-positive rate on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model usually locates contradictions (78.9–79.2%) but scores lower on their category (44.8–49.7%), suggesting as a hypothesis that the fine-grained violation taxonomy may be the hard part, subject to the label-ambiguity caveat above. We make no claim that this difficulty profile transfers to larger or frontier models. The benchmark is automatically scorable under conservative scoring, regenerable for type-3 items by mutation injection, simulation-grounded, and built entirely from public sources. The dataset, simulation harnesses, and scoring pipeline are publicly released at https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread so the community can measure, and improve, models’ ability to read the documents hardware is built from.
paragraphs.zh: SpecRead 将硬件规格的理解与硬件产出的生成区分开来。 作为一项基准测试发布，其初始阶段仅对单一模型进行了评估。结果表明，在一个小型开放模型上存在明显差距：整体准确率为 33.7%（129/383；宏观平均值为 39.4%）；在两种以矛盾检测为核心的类型上，准确率（含判断与定位）为 48.0–65.6%，而这类任务在生成基准测试中尚无对应形式；对于自洽段落，假阳性率为 51.2%；而对于 RTL 一致性对照样本，假阳性率则高达 100%。 分层评分显示，该模型通常能够定位矛盾（准确率为 78.9–79.2%），但在矛盾类型的判断上得分较低（44.8–49.7%）。据此我们提出一个假设：精细化的违规分类可能是其中的难点，当然这一结论也需结合上述标签模糊性的注意事项进行考量。 我们不声称这种难度特征会迁移到更大规模或前沿模型中。 该基准测试支持保守评分下的自动评估，可通过注入变异对类型 3 的项目进行再生成验证，并以模拟结果为基础，且完全基于公开资源构建。 数据集、模拟框架及评分流程已公开发布于 https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread，以便社区能够衡量并提升模型读取硬件构建文档的能力。

paragraphs.en: The lenient variant moves t3 from 24.6% to 40.4%, t4 from 26.0% to 36.5%, and the overall figure from 33.7% to 43.3%. As an independent check on the lenient threshold, counting the 33/93 gray-zone items the adjudication ruled correct on top of the conservative 129/383 gives 162/383 (42.3%, 95% CI [0.375, 0.473]), which sits between the conservative 33.7% and lenient 43.3% figures, corroborating that the lenient threshold tracks human-judged correctness. The qualitative pattern is largely unchanged: retrieval and cross-section reasoning stay well above the contradiction-focused types, and the layered location-vs.-category gap persists. One ordering does flip: under conservative scoring t4 (26.0%) slightly exceeds t3 (24.6%), while under the lenient threshold t3 (40.4%) exceeds t4 (36.5%), reflecting t3’s larger gray zone. The conservative main results are therefore a lower bound on what a more forgiving location rule would credit.
paragraphs.zh: 宽松版本将 t3 的比例从 24.6% 调整至 40.4%，t4 从 26.0% 调整至 36.5%，整体比例则从 33.7% 提升至 43.3%。 作为对宽松阈值的一种独立验证，将裁决判定为正确的 33/93 个灰色地带项目与保守的 129/383 项相加，得到 162/383（42.3%，95% CI [0.375, 0.473]），该数值介于保守的 33.7% 和宽松的 43.3% 之间，证实了宽松阈值能够反映人类判断的正确性。 定性模式基本未变：检索与横截面推理仍显著高于以矛盾分析为主的类型，且分层位置与类别之间的差距依然存在。 有一项排序发生了变化：在保守评分下，t4（26.0%）略高于 t3（24.6%）；而在宽松阈值下，t3（40.4%）则高于 t4（36.5%），这反映了 t3 的灰色地带更大。 因此，保守的主要结果代表了一个更为宽容的位置规则所能认可的下限。

sents.en: The qualitative pattern is largely unchanged: retrieval and cross-section reasoning stay well above the contradiction-focused types, and the layered location-vs.-category gap persists.

sents.en: One ordering does flip: under conservative scoring t4 (26.0%) slightly exceeds t3 (24.6%), while under the lenient threshold t3 (40.4%) exceeds t4 (36.5%), reflecting t3’s larger gray zone.
sents.zh: 有一项排序发生了变化：在保守评分下，t4（26.0%）略高于 t3（24.6%）；而在宽松阈值下，t3（40.4%）则高于 t4（36.5%），这反映了 t3 的灰色地带更大。

sents.en: The conservative main results are therefore a lower bound on what a more forgiving location rule would credit.
sents.zh: 因此，保守的主要结果代表了一个更为宽容的位置规则所能认可的下限。
